threshold_cost_reconciliation.cost_formula: Cost = FP * $10 + FN * $150 + TP * $10 == Flagged * $10 + Missed * $150

coarse_grid_findings.grid_definition: 80 uniformly spaced points in [0.01, 0.80] with step 0.01
coarse_grid_findings.coarse_optimality: Within the 80-point grid, t=0.07 is the unique minimum ($101,590 < $101,720).

discrete_isotonic_step_findings.model_score_distribution: Isotonic regression maps validation inputs to exactly 26 discrete output probability levels.

step_13_mislabeled_as_0_06.root_cause: The $101,130 cost reported in Stage 3.4.2 text table corresponds to score step 13 (u = 0.069074), which was truncated/rounded to '0.06' in the table header, creating confusion against the coarse grid's t=0.06.

true_unconstrained_minimum.root_cause: True minimum cost across all possible thresholds is $101,090 at u=0.067633, which is $500 lower than coarse grid minimum $101,590. Coarse grid of step 0.01 was insufficiently granular to discover this point.

temporal_split_audit.point_in_time_causality: VERIFIED (merge_asof allow_exact_matches=False prevents same-timestamp event leakage)

blind_holdout_threat_model.name: Accidental Label Exposure
blind_holdout_threat_model.mitigation: Holdout labels encrypted with AES-256-GCM (labels_encrypted.bin). Keys held in custody by Independent Auditor.
blind_holdout_threat_model.implementation_status: DESIGNED_AND_TESTED_IN_GATE_FIXTURE (v2.2 labels remain ungenerated and unblinded)

blind_holdout_threat_model.name: Developer Access to Decryption Keys
blind_holdout_threat_model.mitigation: Keys never stored in repository or CI environment accessible to development team. Automated fail-closed check enforces authorization token.

blind_holdout_threat_model.name: Mutable Model or Pipeline After Prediction Generation
blind_holdout_threat_model.mitigation: Cryptographic commit-reveal: SHA-256 prediction array hash committed to audit ledger prior to label release.

blind_holdout_threat_model.name: Repeated Holdout Queries / Adaptive Overfitting
blind_holdout_threat_model.mitigation: Strict single-shot evaluation protocol: exactly one evaluation execution permitted; zero iterative query endpoints.

blind_holdout_threat_model.name: Incorrect Input-to-Prediction Joins
blind_holdout_threat_model.mitigation: Strict validation contract: 1-to-1 order_id matching, zero missing IDs, exact length assertion, no reordering.

blind_holdout_threat_model.name: Selective Removal of Difficult Examples
blind_holdout_threat_model.mitigation: Auditor asserts len(predictions) == len(holdout_orders). Dropped rows fail the evaluation run.

blind_holdout_threat_model.name: Modified Evaluation Code
blind_holdout_threat_model.mitigation: Evaluation runner code hash locked and executed in an immutable container image.

blind_holdout_threat_model.name: Logs Containing Sensitive Holdout Labels
blind_holdout_threat_model.mitigation: Sanitized runner output: logging restricted to aggregate confusion matrix and summary metrics.

blind_holdout_threat_model.name: Unauthorized Holdout Regeneration
blind_holdout_threat_model.mitigation: Holdout seed escrowed with independent auditor; generator script barred from execution without authorized authorization signature.

blind_holdout_threat_model.name: Compromised or Untrusted Evaluation Operator
blind_holdout_threat_model.mitigation: Immutable container execution pinning (OCI image digest) + cryptographic attestation of evaluation runner.

ranking_metrics.primary: PR-AUC (Average Precision) evaluated on continuous probability scores
ranking_metrics.baseline_prevalence_reporting: MANDATORY: Must report positive fraud prevalence alongside PR-AUC

calibration_metrics.secondary: Expected Calibration Error (ECE) with 10 uniform-width bins
calibration_metrics.rule: Calibrator parameters must NOT be fitted on the evaluation cohort. In-sample ECE is forbidden as proof of generalization.

capacity_constraints.tie_breaking: Conservative thresholding (volume <= C); if tied at boundary, order by (score DESC, order_date ASC, order_id ASC)

unresolved_blockers_and_conditions.title: OCI Container Image Digest Pinning
unresolved_blockers_and_conditions.description: Local virtualenv exhibits InconsistentVersionWarning for scikit-learn (1.9.0 vs 1.9.1). An immutable container image digest (e.g., trustshield-evaluator@sha256:...) must be built, verified, and frozen prior to holdout evaluation.
unresolved_blockers_and_conditions.required_action: Build Dockerfile pinning Python 3.14, scikit-learn 1.9.1, xgboost 3.2.0, pandas 3.0.1, numpy 2.3.2; extract immutable sha256 image digest.

unresolved_blockers_and_conditions.title: Tabular-Only Production Model Freezing
unresolved_blockers_and_conditions.description: Late Fusion champion in Stage 3.4 lacked serialized calibrator artifact. The Tabular-Only model (stage34_tabular_model.joblib + stage34_tabular_calibrator.joblib) is verified, fully serialized, and bit-for-bit reproducible.
unresolved_blockers_and_conditions.required_action: Formal research confirmation that Tabular-Only XGBoost is the candidate model for holdout evaluation.

unresolved_blockers_and_conditions.title: Holdout v2.2 Authorization & Key Escrow
unresolved_blockers_and_conditions.description: Holdout v2.2 data generation and label key escrow have not been authorized by project leadership.
unresolved_blockers_and_conditions.required_action: Formal sign-off by independent reviewer on Stage 3.5 protocol before generation and encryption of v2.2 holdout.
